linuxReleaseGate.note: The new test used its inline synthetic fallback because LLAMACODE_OCR_SIDECAR_FIXTURE was not set. This run is not counted as validation of Q49 fixture provenance.

scope.testedChange: QtTest fake loopback flow for an exact synthetic OCR Markdown sidecar through DataLab extraction and schema validation

executionIncidents: Initial compile attempt failed before tests because a fixture identifier was duplicated; a test-only rename fixed it.

An accidental tests-linux.sh --help invocation started a 32-job build because the script has no help mode. Its exact process tree was stopped before tests; no inference/GPU workload or artificial RAM allocation occurred. Peak RSS was not measured for that short attempt.
The full Release gate was rerun serially (LC_JOBS=1); the exact fixture smoke was then run separately with its source path set.
limitations: Does not test automatic OCR of image-only PDFs or real/legal documents.
Does not change production extraction, models, profiles, memory thresholds, swap, or Codex GUI behavior.

The memory-pressure audit confirms high RSS alone did not stop the cited successful ASTRA trace. It does not validate every severe-pressure condition or explain Codex crashes; Q116's alternating PSI false-negative in the active Q97/Q100 per-metric streak logic remains known, and the composite-streak helper is not integrated.
